description: Search Chinese suppliers' product listings and profiles. Returns totals and the best-matching suppliers with their matching listings. Use product words only (e.g. 'bamboo cutting board'). Optional filters apply to the suppliers returned. Spends one search.

certificate.description: A certificate the supplier must list, e.g. BSCI, FDA, LFGB, UL/ETL, OEKO-TEX, FSC

name: search_listings
title: Search supplier listings
